thread:
maria: Hey team — need to lock a 30–45m deployment review with Lumen Edge next week. They've requested VPC + on-prem hybrid readiness and a canary plan review. Can folks share availability and any must-have agenda items? Proposed slots: Tue 9:30–10:15 PT, Wed 16:00–16:45 PT, Thu 11:00–11:45 PT.
jonah: Tue works for me, prefer earlier if possible. I'll bring the routing/fallback notes.
devon: Thu morning is better for infra changes + test harness walkthrough. Also can we confirm who owns the DB migration rollback plan?
sarah: Wed afternoon is okay but I'm out Tue. I'll need the canary metrics pruned into a short doc. cc @maria @jonah :eyes: 
maria: Thanks — assigning pre-reads: 1) canary-playbook draft (https://docs.internal.redwood/lumen-edge/canary-playbook) 2) infra runbook snippet (https://docs.internal.redwood/lumen-edge/infra-runbook) 3) DB migration rollback checklist (https://docs.internal.redwood/lumen-edge/db-rollback). Please comment by EOD Mon if something's missing.
jonah: Added a short section on model fallback policy to the playbook. pinging @devon for network ACL bit.
devon: Ack, will drop ACL diff and the `iptables` snippet into the runbook. Also adding the test harness smoke-test command:
```
./run_smoke_tests --env=staging --parallel=4
```
maria: Quick agenda draft — please react with :thumbsup: if ok or add bullets:
- Introductions & scope (5m)
- VPC topology + peering details (10m)
- Canary plan & metrics to watch (10m)
- DB migration & rollback run-through (5m)
- Rollout timeline & next steps (10m)
jonah: :+1: 
sarah: +1; can we reserve 10m at the end for action owners and immediate blockers?
maria: Yep, added. Also can someone take notes? @devon? 
devon: Happy to take notes. I'll create a meeting doc and link it in the calendar invite.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Lumen Edge — Deployment Review — Wed 2024-06-12 16:00 PT, invite sent to participants.
maria: Great. For visibility, please paste any perf baselines or recent failures in the doc before the meeting. If anything needs a deeper follow-up, we can book a separate deep-dive.
jonah: I'll paste perf counters (p95, p99, memory) and one recent tail-trace.
sarah: FYI I'll be OOO Mon afternoon, will review pre-reads Tue AM.
maria: Thanks all — closing thread. Meeting doc: <https://docs.internal.redwood/lumen-edge/deploy-review>. See you Wed.
